title: Lindblad equation for the quantum Rabi model in the deep strong coupling regime
authors: Daniel Holst, Patrick Potts, Peter Samuelsson
abstract: We derive a quantum master equation in Lindblad form for the open quantum Rabi model in the perturbative deep strong coupling regime, where the spectrum is close to degenerate and harmonic. The Lindblad form is obtained by combining secular and singular-coupling approximations, working in a Schrieffer-Wolff transformed frame. We benchmark our equation against a Bloch-Redfield one, analyzing the time-evolution and steady state properties of several observables and find excellent agreement. Analytical results are obtained in limiting cases.
summary: This paper develops a quantum master equation in Lindblad form for the open quantum Rabi model operating in the deep strong coupling regime. By combining the Schrieffer-Wolff transformation with advanced approximations, the authors derive a highly accurate equation. This new formulation successfully models the time evolution and steady state of key observables, showing strong consistency with established methods like the Bloch-Redfield approach.
main_problem: The paper derives a quantum master equation in Lindblad form for the open quantum Rabi model in the perturbative deep strong coupling (pDSC) regime.
main_result: A compact Lindblad equation is derived that shows excellent agreement when benchmarked against the Bloch-Redfield equation, accurately describing the time evolution and steady state of observables.
method: The derivation combines the Schrieffer-Wolff transformation with secular and singular-coupling approximations applied to the Bloch-Redfield framework.
model_or_system: The system is the quantum Rabi model, describing a two-level system (qubit) coupled to a single harmonic oscillator mode (cavity). The dynamics are governed by a master equation derived in the transformed Schrieffer-Wolff basis.
key_observables: Occupancy $\langle \hat{c}^\dagger \hat{c} angle(t)$, parity $\langle \hat{\pi}_z angle(t)$, and coherence $|\langle \hat{c}\hat{\pi}_z angle(t)|$.
important_parameters: The deep strong coupling (pDSC) regime, characterized by $|	ext{E}_{n,+}-	ext{E}_{n,-}| \ll \omega_c$, and the coupling strength $\eta = g/\omega_c$.
main_assumptions: The use of the Born-Markov approximation, the Schrieffer-Wolff transformation, and approximations involving grouping frequencies into clusters.
figures_summary: Figure 1 illustrates the lowest energy eigenvalues $E_{n,\pi_z}$ versus the coupling strength $\eta$, demonstrating the spectral structure in the regime studied.
paper_structure: The paper first establishes the physical model and the need for the master equation. It derives the Lindblad form by refining the Bloch-Redfield equation using the Schrieffer-Wolff transformation. Key results include analyzing the infinite coupling limit and benchmarking the final equation against known limits and observables.
why_interesting: This work provides a rigorous, advanced theoretical tool (the Lindblad equation) to model complex open quantum systems like cavity QED setups, which is central to modern AMO physics research.
